{{Quote|First Nerrik. Then Jak, then Haze. Now Ford. I don't think I can take it anymore.|One of Sylas Wilkes's men|<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|Into the Dune Sea|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Jak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal in the employ of [[Sylas Wilkes]] who was one of fifteen men tasked with guarding a shipment of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and a [[Tulak Hord's artifact (Tatooine)|Sith artifact]] for their boss on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. However, the artifact drove the group mad, and they fled into the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] with the blasters and the artifacts. As the artifact's influence over them grew, they were picked off one by one by either the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] or themselves&mdash;one of the group believed that [[Paal]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Haze]] in his sleep because he had the artifact, and though Paal claimed it was the Sand People, Jak accused Paal of killing Haze and was killed that night.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jak is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Tatooine.
